data.title: System Integration
data.tagline: One accountable team across vendors, protocols, and sites.
data.overview: We take responsibility for the seams. Meridian coordinates vendors, designs the integration layer, tests the whole system, and stays accountable when something does not behave as specified.

problems.title: Vendor finger-pointing
problems.description: Each supplier proves its own box works while the line still fails.

problems.title: Protocol gaps
problems.description: Legacy equipment and modern platforms speak different languages.

problems.title: Inconsistent handover
problems.description: Every site receives a different standard of documentation and support.

approach.title: Interface map
approach.description: Every dependency, protocol, owner, and test written down before build.

approach.title: Integration layer
approach.description: A controlled boundary rather than hundreds of point-to-point links.

approach.title: End-to-end test
approach.description: Scenario-based testing across vendors, not only factory acceptance of individual packages.

approach.title: Operate and support
approach.description: A single support model with defined escalation and change control.

capabilities.title: OT/IT integration
capabilities.description: Secure, observable data exchange between control and enterprise systems.

capabilities.title: Middleware
capabilities.description: MQTT, OPC UA, APIs, and event orchestration with clear contracts.

capabilities.title: Migration
capabilities.description: Phased transition from legacy interfaces with rollback plans.

capabilities.title: Managed support
capabilities.description: Monitoring, patching, and improvement under an agreed service model.

benefits.title: One accountable owner
benefits.description: A single team responsible for end-to-end behaviour.

benefits.title: Faster fault isolation
benefits.description: Observable interfaces show where the problem actually is.

benefits.title: Reusable standards
benefits.description: The next site starts from a proven integration pattern.

benefits.title: Lower lifecycle cost
benefits.description: Documented contracts reduce rework and vendor lock-in.
